language.label: Ururimi
language.otherFooter: Tuzasebanura porogaramu mu rurimi rwawe dukoresheje ubwenge bw’ubukorano. Bishobora kugira amakosa.
language.translating: Birimo guhindurira Landed mu rurimi rwa {language}…
language.notConfigured: Guhindura mu rurimi rushya bisaba urufunguzo rwa API ya Gemini ku rubuga.
language.unknownLanguage: Ntitwashoboye kubona urwo rurimi. Reba niba rwanditse neza wongere ugerageze.

disclaimer: Landed isobanura amakuru. Si inama z’amategeko. Ku kibazo cyawe,agana umunyamategeko cyangwa umuntu wemewe.

landing.hero: Umwaka wawe wa mbere muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika, ufite umuyobozi n’inshuti nke.
landing.sub: Sobanukirwa amabaruwa yawe, kurikirana italiki z’ingenzi, shakisha ubufasha bwizewe, uhure n’abantu banyuze muri byo.
landing.whyIntro: Ibi bigira ingaruka ku bantu benshi cyane, ariko ntajya wumva bivugwa cyane. Ingaruka ziba mu rwihishwa: urupapuro ruyoberanye, igihe ntarengwa cyarenze, cyangwa “notario” w’umubeshyi.
landing.stat1: by’abantu bari bafite imanza mu rukiko rw’abimukira bari bafite umunyamategeko mu mwaka wa 2026, bikaba ari byo byari hasi cyane kuva mu 2026.
landing.stat2: by’abantu basabye uburenganzira nta munyamategeko bageze kuri byinshi, mu bushakashatsi bwakozwe ku rwego rw’igihugu ku manza zirenga miliyoni 1.2 z’abajyanwa mu bihugu byabo.
landing.stat3: Imiryango ikoresha ururimi rumwe yari isanzwe igira amahirwe angana n’incuro eshanu yo kutagira konti muri banki (ishingiye ku bushakashatsi bwa FDIC).
landing.statsFooter: Uburiganya bwa notario ntibuvugwa bihagije kuko abahohotewe batinya kubigaragaza. Abana bakunze gusobanurira ababyeyi babo fagitire, amasezerano y’inzu n’amapapuro y’amategeko.
landing.pitch: Ubufasha burahari. Gusa abantu ntibabasha kububona, kubisoma, cyangwa kumenya igice kibareba.
landing.privacy: Nta konti isabwa. Nta na kimwe gisohoka muri telefoni yawe keretse niba ubisabye. Ntitubika na rimwe amafoto y’ibyangombwa byawe.

notario.title: Notario ntashobora gutanga inama z’amategeko
notario.body: Abavoka n’abahagarariye bemewe na DOJ gusa nibo bashobora gutanga inama z’amategeko ku bijyanye n’abimukira. “Notario” ntashobora kubikora. Muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika, umuntu utangiza inyandiko ashobora gusa kuba umuhamya w’umukono.

guarantee.title: Nta n’umwe ushobora kwemeza icyemezo cy’aho uba
guarantee.body: Nta n’umwe ushobora kwemeza ko uzabona icyemezo cy’aho uba cyangwa ngo agushyire ku “rutonde rwihariye.” Hari umuntu wemeye ibitangaza cyangwa usabye amafaranga yo kwihutisha ibintu, ibyo ni ikimenyetso cy’akaga.

forms.title: Impapuro za USCIS ni ubuntu
forms.body: Impapuro zemewe za USCIS ni ubuntu kuzikura kuri uscis.gov. Hari ubusabe bugira amafaranga y’ubwishyu, ariko impapuro z ubwazo ntizishyirwa amafaranga. Imbuga za leta zemewe zirangira na .gov.

checkLawyer.title: Uburyo bwo kugenzura umuvoka
checkLawyer.short: Murebe mu nzego z’abavoka z’intara yawe.
checkLawyer.body: Shaka umuvoka mu nzego z’abavoka z’intara afiteho uruhushya. Muri Texas, koresha ishakisha rya State Bar of Texas “Find a Lawyer”. Ku bahagarariye bemewe, reba urutonde rwa DOJ (EOIR).

tenant.title: Iby’ibanze ku mukodesha
tenant.body: Soma amasezerano yawe y’ubukode kandi ubike kopi. Nyir’inzu ntashobora kukwirukana ahindura ingufuri cyangwa afata ibintu byawe; kwirukanwa bigomba kunyura mu rukiko. Nubona impapuro z’urukiko, ntuzirengagize.

workplace.title: Iby’ibanze ku kazi
workplace.short: Umushahara muto n’amasaha y’inyongera bireba abakozi benshi.
workplace.body: Abakozi benshi bagomba guhabwa byibuze umushahara muto wa Leta n’inyongera y’amasaha y’akaziarenze 40 mu cyumweru. Ishami ry’Abakozi ryakira ibirego by’umushahara hatitawe ku ITERABERE ry’ubwimukira. Bika inyandiko y’amasaha yawe n’umushahara.

scan.title: Soma ibaruwa
scan.intro: Fata ifoto y’ibaruwa cyangwa y’urupfu. Turayisobanura mu rurimi rworoshye.
scan.privacy: Ifoto yawe isomwa rimwe gusa ngo isobanurwe, hanyuma igashyingurwa. Ntibiba byiza ko ibikwa.
scan.protectingNote: Ibi bikorerwa kuri telefone yawe. Nta na kimwe kirererezwa.
scan.reviewIntro: Imirongo y’umukara ihisha amakuru yawe yiteguriye. Kopi yakingiwe gusa ni yo yoherezwa ngo isomwe.
scan.foundCount: {count, plural, =0 {Ntitwabonye amakuru yiteguriye mu buryo bwikora.} one {Twahishe amakuru # yihariye: {kinds}.} other {Twahishe amakuru # yihariye: {kinds}.}}
scan.ocrFailed: Ntushoboye gusoma ibiri kuri telefone yawe. Kurura kuri ikintu cyose cy’ibanga kugira ngo ugihishe.
scan.reviewHelp: Kurura ku bindi byose ushaka guhisha. Kanda ku murongo w’umukara kugira ngo wongere ubone ibirimo.
scan.reviewImageAlt: Inyandiko yawe ifite amakuru yihariye yahishwe
scan.rejected_blurry: Iyi foto irasa n’ibihu cyane ku buryo idasomeka
scan.rejected_dark: Iyi foto irijimye cyane ku buryo idasomeka
scan.rejected_bright: Iyi foto ifite urumuri rwinshi cyane cyangwa amabara yayo yarazimye
scan.rejected_unreadable: Ntidushobora gusoma igice gihagije cy’iyi foto
scan.rejectedBody: Kugira ngo dusobanure ibaruwa yawe neza kandi dupfuke amakuru yawe bwite, dukeneye foto igaragara neza. Nta kintu cyoherejwe.
scan.tipsTitle: Kugira ngo ufate foto igaragara neza
scan.tip1: Shyira ibaruwa iringaniye ku meza yijimye.
scan.tip2: Koresha urumuri rwinshi kandi rungana. Irinde igicucu n’urumuri rubengerana.
scan.tip3: Fata telefone igororotse hejuru y’urupapuro kugira ngo urupapuro wuzure kuri ekirani.
scan.tip4: Kanda kuri ekirani kugira ngo ifate neza, hanyuma ntunyeganyege.
scan.samplesFooter: Inyandiko z’ibihimbano zifite amazina n’imibare byashyizweho kugira ngo ugerageze porogaramu.
scan.tooBig: Iyo foto iraremereye cyane. Gerageza indi.
scan.notConfigured: Gusoma urwandiko bisaba urufunguzo rwa AI kuri seriveri. Ahubwo gerageza urwandiko rw’icyitegererezo.

ask.title: Baza Ikibazo
ask.emptyTitle: Baza ku buzima muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika
ask.emptySub: Igisubizo gituruka ku masoko yizewe. Ku bibazo bijyanye n’ikibazo cyiteganyijwe kuri wowe, tuzagufasha kubona umuhanga.
ask.q1: Ni iki gitandukanya ikarita ya girikandi (green card) n’uruhushya rwo gukora?
ask.q3: Namenya nte ko umunyamategeko ari nyirizina?
ask.q4: Notario ni iki kandi kuki ngomba kwitonda?
ask.findHelp: Shakisha ubufasha bw’amategeko bw’ubuntu hafi yawe

help.title: Shakisha ubufasha bw’amategeko bw’ubuntu
help.ilhSub: Ubufasha bw’amategeko butari ubw’ubucuruzi bukoresha kode y’aho utuye (ZIP code)
help.eoir: Urutonde rw’abikorera ku bushake rwa EOIR
help.eoirSub: Abatanga ubufasha bw’ubuntu banditse mu nkiko z’abinjira n’abasohoka
help.verify1: Baza niba uwo ugufasha ari umwavoka wemewe cyangwa uhagarariye wemewe na DOJ.
help.verify2: Shakisha abavoka ku rutonde rw’abavoka b’intara (state bar). Shakisha abahagarariye ku rutonde rwa EOIR.
help.verify3: Ntuzigere usinya impapuro zitujuje cyangwa ngo utange ibyangombwa bya nyabyo.
help.verify4: Baza ibiciro mbere y’uko mubonana bwa mbere.

prep.intro: Kora icyegeranyo cy’urupapuro rumwe uzashyira umunyamategeko cyangwa umuhagarariwe wemewe. Cyanditse mu rurimi rwawe no mu Cyongereza.
prep.noDates: Nta matariki arimo. Ushobora kongeraho ibibazo.

i94.title: Bonera kopi y’urupapuro rwawe rwa I-94
i94.short: Inyandiko yawe yemewe y’aho wahereye ugera hano. Reba amatariki ariho.
i94.body: I-94 ni inyandiko ya Leta yerekana igihe wageze hano n’igihe ushobora kumara hano. Ibiro byinshi birayisaba, kandi itariki iriho irakenewe cyane. Ushobora kuyibona ku buntu kuri interineti.

steps.s1: Jya ku rubuga rwa interineti rwemewe rwa I-94. Ni ubuntu.
steps.s2: Hitamo “Get Most Recent I-94” hanyuma wandike izina ryawe na pasiporo yawe uko byanditswe muri pasiporo.
steps.s3: Reba izina ryawe, ubwoko bw’icyo winjiriyemo, ndetse n’itariki ya “Admit Until”.
steps.s4: Bika cyangwa usohore kopi yayo uyibike hamwe na pasiporo yawe.
steps.s5: Hari ikitarimo neza? Ibiro bya CBP Deferred Inspection bishobora kugufasha kubikosora.

ssn.title: Bona nimero y’ubwiteganyiriza bw’abakozi (Social Security number)
ssn.short: Uyikeneye kugira ngo ukore no mu bindi bintu byinshi.
ssn.body: Nimero ya Social Security (SSN) ikoreshwa mu kazi, mu misoro, no muri banki. Si buri wese ushobora kuyibona. Bitewe n’uko uhagaze mu by’abimukira n’uburenganzira bwo gukora. Ikarita n’iyi nimero ni ubuntu burundu.

steps.s1: Menya niba ushobora kubona iyi nimero n’inyandiko ukeneye.
steps.s2: Tondeka inyandiko zawe: akenshi ni pasiporo yawe, icyemezo cy’uko uri umunyamahanga, n’icyemezo cy’imyaka yawe.
steps.s3: Tangira gusaba kuri interineti cyangwa ujye ku biro bya Social Security biri hafi yawe.
steps.s4: Tegereza ikarita yawe mu iposita. Uyibike ahantu hatekanye, ntiyishyire mu mufuka wawe w’amafaranga.

address.title: Menyesha USCIS igihe wimukiye ahandi
address.short: Abantu benshi bagomba kumenyesha aho batuye hashya mu minsi 10.
address.body: Abatari abaturage benshi bagomba kumenyesha USCIS aho batuye hashya mu minsi 10 nyuma yo kwimuka. Nurabikora, ushobora kubura amakuru y’ingenzi cyangwa amabaruwa. Ni ubuntu.

steps.s1: Nimwimuka, andika itariki. Akenshi uba ufite iminsi 10.
steps.s2: Hindura aho utuye kuri interineti kuri USCIS.
steps.s3: Niba ufite urubanza mu rukiko rw’abimukira, ugomba no kubimenyesha urukiko ukoresha fagitire ya EOIR-33.
steps.s4: Bika urupapuro rwemeza ko wabikoze cyangwa ubutumwa bwa email.

bank.title: Fungura konti muri banki
bank.short: Bika amafaranga yawe neza kandi wirinde amafaranga yo kwishyuza cheques.
bank.body: Konti muri banki cyangwa koperative y’imari (credit union) irinda amafaranga yawe kuruta kuyabitika mu ntoki kandi igufasha kubaka amateka meza muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika. Banki zimwe zemera pasiporo cyangwa indangamuntu ya konsila.

steps.s1: Gereranya banki na koperative z’imari. Reba amafaranga yishyurwa buri kwezi n’amafaranga make agomba kuguma kuri konti.
steps.s2: Zana indangamuntu yawe (pasiporo cyangwa indangamuntu ya konsila) na SSN cyangwa ITIN niba uzifite. Baza inyandiko zemewe.
steps.s3: Fungura konti maze usabe ikarita ya banki yo kwishyuraho (debit card).
steps.s4: Irinde aho baha abantu amafaranga ya cheques. Amafaranga yabo yo hejuru ni menshi.

links.l1: Konti za banki (Consumer Financial Protection Bureau)

stateId.title: Bona indangamuntu y’intara cyangwa uruhushya rwo gutwara ibinyabiziga
stateId.short: Indangamuntu y’aho utuye iriho ifoto yorohereza ibintu byinshi.
stateId.body: Ikarita y’indangamuntu ya Leta cyangwa uruhushya rwo gutwara ibinyabiziga byemewe hose hafi. Buri Leta ifite amategeko yayo y’impapuro ukeneye.

steps.s1: Shaka ibiro bitanga uruhushya rwo gutwara ibinyabiziga bya Leta yawe.
steps.s3: Fata gahunda niba Leta yawe ibisaba.
steps.s4: Zana impapuro zawe n’amafaranga ku biro byawe.

links.l1: Shaka ibiro bishinzwe ibinyabiziga bya Leta yawe (USA.gov)
links.l2: Uruhushya rwo gutwara ibinyabiziga n’indangamuntu bya Texas (Texas DPS)

itin.title: Fata ITIN niba utabasha kubona SSN
itin.short: Nimero y’imisoro ku bantu batabasha kubona nimero ya Social Security.

steps.s1: Reba niba ukeneye ITIN. Uyikeneye gusa niba utabasha kubona SSN.
steps.s3: Uyohereze hamwe n’imisoro yawe, cyangwa ubone ubufasha buntu ku Mujyanama wemewe na IRS.
steps.s4: Tegereza ibaruwa ya IRS iriho nimero yawe. Uyibike neza.

taxes.title: Tanga imisoro yawe
taxes.short: Imisoro akensunyi isabwa hagati muri Mata. Hari ubufasha buntu.
taxes.body: Niba warakoreye amafaranga muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika, ushobora gukeneka gutanga imisoro, akensunyi bitarenze Mata 15. Gutanga ku gihe bishobora no kugufasha kubona amafaranga yisubiza n’ibyiza. Hari ubufasha buntu bw’imisoro.

steps.s1: Teranya impapuro zawe z’imisoro uvuye ku kazi, nka W-2 cyangwa 1099.
steps.s2: Shaka ubufasha buntu bw’imisoro hafi yawe (VITA).
steps.s3: Tanga imisoro yawe bitarenze igihe ntarengwa, akensunyi ni Mata 15.

credit.title: Tangira kwubaka uburyo bwo kwizerwa mu by’imari
credit.short: Kwizerwa mu by’imari bigufasha gukodesha inzu no kubona inguzanyo.
credit.body: Amateka yawe y’imari agaragaza uko wishyuza fagitire. Abanyamituriko n’abatanga inguzanyo barayibona. Ushobora kuyubaka buhoro buhoro kandi ukagenzura raporo zawe ku buntu.

steps.s1: Menya icyo raporo z’imari n’amanota bivuga.
steps.s2: Bona raporo zawe z’imari z’ubuntu uzigenzuremo amakosa.
steps.s4: Tekereza kuri karita y’inguzanyo yishingiye, kandi ntuzishyure umuntu wese usezeranya “gukosora” imari yawe.

workPermit.title: Menya igihe uruhushya rwawe rwo gukora ruzarangirira
workPermit.short: Ongeraho igihe cyo kurangira kugira ngo utagihusha.
workPermit.body: Uruhushya rwo gukora (EAD) rufite igihe cyo kurangira. Abantu bamwe bashobora gusaba urushya rushya mbere y’uko rurangira. Igihe n’uburyo biterwa n’icyiciro cyawe, bityo reba urupapuro rwemewe ubike itariki.

steps.s1: Shaka itariki y’irangirira kuri karita yawe uyishyire mu matariki yawe.
steps.s2: Soma igihe n’uburyo ushobora gusaba kongera igihe (Ifishi I-765).
steps.s3: Niba utanga impapuro kuri interineti, koresha konti ya USCIS.
steps.s4: Bika icyemezo cy’uko wakiriwe kandi ugenzure uko dosiye yawe ihagaze.

wages.title: Menya uburenganzira bwawe ku kazi
wages.short: Umushahara muto n’amasaha y’inyongera bireba abakozi benshi.
wages.body: Abakozi benshi bagomba kubona nibura umushahara muto n’amafaranga y’inyongera y’amasaha yarenzeho. Ishami ry’Abakozi ryakira ibirego by’abakozi batitaye ku miterere yabo yo kuba abinjira n’abasohoka.

steps.s1: Menya umushahara muto muri Leta yawe.
steps.s2: Andika amasaha yawe kandi ubike impapuro z’umushahara wawe.
steps.s3: Niba utishyuwe ibyo udebeye, ushobora gutanga ikirego.

health.title: Shaka ubuvuzi bw’abaturage buhendutse
health.short: Ibigo Nderabuzima by’abaturage bishyurisha hashingiwe ku mafaranga winjiza.
health.body: Ibigo Nderabuzima by’abaturage bivura abarwayi ndetse n’abatagira ubwishingizi kandi bikishyurisha hashingiwe ku mafaranga binjiza. Abinjira bamwe bashobora no kubona ubwishingizi bw’ubuzima. Ibyumba by’ihutirwaho bigomba kukuvura mu bihe by’ubihutirwaho.

steps.s1: Shaka ikigo nderabuzima cy’abaturage hafi yawe.
steps.s3: Zana indangamuntu n’icyemezo cy’amafaranga winjiza ku gusura kwawe kwa mbere.
steps.s4: Mu bihe by’ihutirwaho, jya mu cyumba cy’ihutirwaho cyangwa uhamagare 911.

school.title: Andikisha abana bawe ku ishuri
school.short: Abana bose bafite uburenganzira bwo kwiga mu mashuri ya Leta.
school.body: Mu Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika, abana bose bashobora kwiga mu mashuri ya Leta ku buntu, uko ibyangombwa byabo byaba bimeze kose. Amashuri ntashobora kubaza ibijyanye n'ibyangombwa by'abinjira n'abasohoka kugira ngo yandikishe umwana.

steps.s2: Shaka icyemezo cy'imyaka y'umwana wawe n'icyemezo cy'aho utuye.
steps.s3: Uzura impapuro zo kwiyandikisha. Saba ubufasha mu rurimi rwawe.
steps.s4: Saba ubufasha bw'abiga icyongereza ku mwana wawe.

selectiveService.title: Kwiyandikisha muri Selective Service (abagabo bafite imimyaka 18–25)
selectiveService.short: Abagabo benshi bafite imyaka 18 kugeza kuri 25 batuye muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika bagomba kwiyandikisha.
selectiveService.body: Abagabo benshi bafite imyaka 18 kugeza kuri 25 batuye muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika, harimo n'abinjira n'abasohoka benshi, bagomba kwiyandikisha muri Selective Service. Kwiyandikisha ni ubuntu kandi byoroshye.

steps.s1: Reba niba ukeneye kwiyandikisha. Ni cyane cyane abagabo bafite imyaka 18 kugeza kuri 25.

legalHelp.title: Shaka ubufasha bw'amategeko ku buntu ushobora kwiringira
legalHelp.short: Menya uwo ushobora gusaba inama ku byerekeye abinjira n'abasohoka mbere y'uko ubikenera.
legalHelp.body: Abavoka n'abagaragiye ba DOJ bemerewe bonyine ni bo batanga inama z'amategeko y'abinjira n'abasohoka. Shaka itsinda ry'abafasha mu mategeko ku buntu cyangwa rihendutse hafi yawe mbere y'uko ubikenera.

steps.s1: Shakisha ubufasha bw'amategeko ku buntu cyangwa rihendutse hafi yawe.
steps.s2: Menya neza ko uwo muntu ari umuvoka cyangwa umuhagararije wemewe na DOJ.
steps.s3: Baza igiciro mbere y'inama yanyu ya mbere.
steps.s4: Zana kopi z'ibyangombwa byawe. Bika iby'umwimerere.

scams.title: Wige kumenya ubutekamutwe bw'abinjira n'abasohoka
scams.short: Notarios ntibashobora gutanga inama z'amategeko. Impapuro ni ubuntu.
scams.body: Abatekamutwe bagambira abinjira n'abasohoka. “Notario” ntashobora gutanga inama z'amategeko, nta n'umwe ushobora kwizeza green card, kandi impapuro za USCIS zikurwa kuri interineti ku buntu.

steps.s1: Wige ubutekamutwe bw'abinjira n'abasohoka bukunze kugaragara.
steps.s2: Kurura impapuro kuri uscis.gov honyine. Ni ubuntu.
steps.s3: Niba hari uwagerageza kuguha ubutekamutwe, birohoze.

tenant.title: Menya uburenganzira bwawe nk'umukodesha
tenant.short: Nyir'inzu agomba kunyura mu rukiko kugira ngo akwirukane.

steps.s1: Soma amasezerano yawe y'ubukode kandi ubike kopi.
steps.s2: Saba ibikorwa byo gusanwa mu nyandiko kandi ubike kopi.
steps.s3: Wige uko uburyo bwo kwirukana bukora.
steps.s4: Niba ubonye impapuro z'urukiko, ntuzirengagize. Shaka ubufasha bw'amategeko ku buntu.

travel.title: Mbere y'uko ujya urugendo hanze ya Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika
travel.short: Kugenda gushobora kugira icyo bihungabanya ku rubanza ruri mu nzira. Banza ubaze.
travel.body: Ku binjira n'abasohoka benshi, kuva muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika gushobora kugira icyo bihungabanya ku cyifuzo cyatanzwe cyangwa ubushobozi bwo kugaruka. Abantu bamwe bakeneye urupapuro rw'urugendo mbere y'uko bagenda. Niba byizewe bitewe n'uko uhagaze.

steps.s1: Mbere y'uko ugura tike, wige ibyangombwa by'urugendo bihari.
steps.s2: Soma ibyerekeye Advance Parole na Re-entry Permits (Form I-131).
steps.s3: Vugana n'ubufasha bw'amategeko ku buntu ku bijyanye n'uko uhagaze mbere y'uko ujya urugendo.
steps.s4: Twara ibyangombwa byawe by'abinjira n'abasohoka igihe cyose ujya urugendo.

benefits.title: Ubufasha bwa Leta n'ibyangombwa byawe
benefits.short: Ushobora kubona ubufasha bitewe n'ibyangombwa byawe. Banza ubaze mbere y'uko usaba.
benefits.body: Porogaramu zimwe zifasha mu biribwa, ubuvuzi n'aho kuba. Ushobora kubibona bitewe n'ibyangombwa by'abinjira n'abasohoka, kandi rimwe na rimwe gukoresha ubufasha bwa leta bishobora kugira umumaro ku cyifuzo cy'ejo hazaza. Saba ubufasha bw'amategeko ku buntu mbere y'uko usaba.

steps.s1: Wige porogaramu z'ubufasha bwa leta zihari.
steps.s2: Uburenganzira bushingiye ku byangombwa byawe. Saba ubufasha bw'amategeko ku buntu icyo wakora.
steps.s3: Abana bavukiye muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika bashobora kubona uburenganzira n'ubwo ababyeyi babo batabufite.
steps.s4: Buri gihe vugisha ukuri ku byo usaba.

court.title: Niba ufite itariki y'urukiko rw'abinjira n'abasohoka
court.short: Ntuzigere ucikwa n'urubanza. Reba urubanza rwawe kuri interineti.
court.body: Niba ufite urubanza mu rukiko rw’abinjira n’abasohoka,gusiba urubanza bishobora kugira ingaruka zikomeye. Ushobora kureba itariki y’urubanza rwawe rutaha kuri interineti ukoresheje nimero yawe ya A-number.

steps.s1: Reba itariki y’urubanza rwawe rutaha kuri interineti.
steps.s2: Shyira itariki y’urubanza mu matariki yawe.
steps.s3: Niba wimutse, bwire urukiko mu minsi 5 ukoresheje fagitire ya EOIR-33.
steps.s4: Shakisha ubufasha bw’abunganizi mu mategeko bw’ubuntu vuba bishoboka.
steps.s5: Jya mu manza zose, kabiri niyo waba utarabona umunamategeko.

legalHelpCard.title: Vugana n’abunganizi mu mategeko b’ubuntu
legalHelpCard.body: Ibi biterwa n’aho uhagaze mu mategeko y’abinjira n’abasohoka. Ishyirahamwe ry’ubufasha bw’amategeko bw’ubuntu rishobora gusuzuma ibyawe.
